label: 4th original token (t=3), esp. p/r/l/n/y/3/c/i
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, at early positions: 87% of mass at t=3 (4th original token), 10% at t=2, 3% at t=4; never at t=0-1, t>=5, the delimiter, or the copy phase. Within t=3 it is strongly token-dependent: input p, r, l, n, y, 3, c, i have the highest rates (p/r ~5x lift), while s, h, k rarely fire. Mostly first occurrences of the token (90% of mass). Magnitude is modulated by the previous tokens: the top activations are t=3 after prev_tok i (e.g. h w i [r], h x i [p]); prev_tok l/x/c/g also boost. Position alone (t==3) gives recall 0.78 / mass 0.87 but precision 0.10; adding the input-token set raises precision to ~0.30. The remaining selectivity depends on a combination of the prefix tokens not captured by a simple predicate.
